colorblind-simulator.title: Color Blindness Simulator Pro
colorblind-simulator.intro: A professional color vision deficiency (CVD) simulator. It models 8 vision types in real time — protanopia, protanomaly, deuteranopia, deuteranomaly, tritanopia, tritanomaly, achromatopsia and blue-cone monochromacy — and transforms a single color, an entire palette or an uploaded image. Includes a WCAG 2.1 contrast checker, a CIE Delta-E confusion matrix and color-blind-safe palette suggestions. Everything runs locally in your browser; images are never uploaded.
